newsitem.title: CANADA: Zemex, IMCO in proposed joint deal.
newsitem.headline: Zemex, IMCO in proposed joint deal.

text.p: Zemex Corp said on Wednesday it has signed a letter of understanding with IMCO Recycling Inc to form a joint venture.
The proposal, through Zemex's wholly owned subsidiary Alumitech Inc, would apply to the supply and processing of aluminum dross and saltcake, Zemex said in a statement.
The agreement calls for Cleveland-based Alumitech to contribute its technology and Texas-based IMCO to supply the feedstock requirements for the operation of a new facility.
Each partner wil share equally in capital costs of the new facility, Zemex said.
The letter of understanding is subject to due diligence and a definitive agreement.
